Battery usage of this app is restricted. Android may stop the server while the screen is off. Choose Unrestricted for MCP Server in the system battery settings.
Run this command in PowerShell or Bash on the computer where Claude Code is installed.
Copy the configuration for your client, then confirm its first pairing request on this device.
Add this section to ~/.codex/config.toml. Copy and run the PowerShell command separately, then start Codex from that same terminal so it inherits the token.
Start the server with the MCP Server switch in the AutoJs6 drawer. For USB, run the adb forward command on the computer. With several devices, add -s followed by the device serial.
Save this JSON in .cursor/mcp.json. If a file already exists, merge the autojs6 entry into its mcpServers object.
Enable %1$s? Paired clients will be able to perform these operations on this device.
Enable local browser access for MCP Inspector and token access through adb diagnostics? Authentication and pairing remain required. Restarting the listener applies the change.
Cannot start. Check the port and network.
Use this HTTP server entry in a client that supports mcpServers JSON and Authorization headers.
Install and enable AutoJs6 to start the server.
Off by default. Stops the server after the chosen time without requests from clients; a client that stays connected without sending requests does not keep it running. Pairing and the token are kept.
Stop automatically when idle: after %1$d min without requests
Clients must join the same network as the phone; guest networks and AP isolation block them. When a connection times out, check the router and the firewall of the computer.
No local network address yet. Connect the phone to Wi-Fi.
Daily reminder while listening on the local network
Allow other computers on this network to reach the server over HTTP? Use a trusted network. The token and phone pairing are still required.
Local network access is off by default. Port and network changes restart an active listener. Existing clients may need to reconnect.
The selected clients will need approval on the phone before their next tool call or resource access.
Allow paired clients to request root Shell commands? AutoJs6 must also grant root access. These commands can change system files.
Replace the token now? The old token stops working immediately. Update client credentials afterwards. Existing pairings are kept.
